entries.text: You remember how it all works, right? Once you\nget badges from all the Gyms...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_01

entries.text: you get to throw down against the strongest\nPokémon Trainers around![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_02

entries.text: Yes. You must face the Pokémon League.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_01

entries.text: It is located to the northwest of Mesagoza.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_02

entries.text: The Pokémon League is where Trainers are\nreborn as Champions—the greatest honor that\r\nthey might dream of.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_03

entries.text: Collecting eight Gym Badges sets you up to\ntake the Champion Assessment.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_03

entries.text: If you can face the challenge of the final\nexaminer and win, you’ll become a Champion![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_04

entries.text: Just imagine how that moment would feel.\nTry getting into that Champion mindset![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_19

entries.text: Now, set your sights on reaching that big,\nimportant stage...and let’s battl—[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_05

entries.text: Excuse me one moment.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I believe [VAR 0x0100(0000)]’s
Pokémon
may
still
be
a
little
fatigued.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_05

entries.text: Sorry! Got a little caught up in my battle hunger.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_06

entries.text: Well, you should all be in great shape now thanks\nto La Primera![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_07

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]OK, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Time to put
our
game
faces
back on![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_08

entries.text: Let’s have us another fruitful battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_09

entries.text: An amazing display of talent, even against one\nas skilled as Champion Nemona.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_06

entries.text: That was a splendid match. I enjoyed watching\nvery much.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_07

entries.text: Now even La Primera thinks you’re one to watch.\nYou’ve got so much potential![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_10

entries.text: The way you’re going, I better watch my back![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_11

entries.text: Did battling in front of La Primera give you the\njitters, maybe?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_12

entries.text: Well, I might’ve won, but it was obvious how\nmuch you’ve bonded with your Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_13

entries.text: Y’know, since the first time we met, I’ve been\nweirdly sure of one thing...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_14

entries.text: You’re gonna become a Champion—no doubt\nabout it, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_15

entries.text: The rest of these Gyms? You can take ’em!\nHundred percent, no problem![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_16

entries.text: I agree. In fact, you should take this. Consider it\nan investment in your future.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_08

entries.text: If a Pokémon uses that move while Terastallized,\nthe move’s type will change to the Tera Type\r\nof the Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_12

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]One day, [VAR 0x0100(0000)], you and
me
are
gonna
have
the
greatest
battle
of
all!
I know it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_17

entries.text: I’m gonna go train up—even more than I already\nhave been![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0110_rival_18

entries.text: She shows you such support and friendship.\nOr perhaps...\c\nPerhaps she hopes you truly might rival her?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_09

entries.text: No... I think it’s no mere hope. She seems to have\ncomplete faith that you will catch up to her.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_10

entries.text: At any rate, allow me to return you to the Gym\nwhere I found you.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: champ_0110_chairman_11
